items.title: Warn when project-specific settings are passed to non-project `uv run` commands
items.reason: Introduced the exact --frozen/--no-project warning in August 2024. Its purpose was to warn about ignored project options; it did not address suppressing warnings for inherited environment settings.

items.title: Warn when project options are used with `uv run` outside a project
items.reason: The original request behind astral-sh/uv#5977 explains why these warnings exist. It requested warnings for ignored options, whereas this report concerns misleading warnings from environment-only defaults.

items.title: Unfriendly error message when `uv lock` or `uv sync` with `UV_FROZEN=1` env variable
items.reason: Related precedent for confusing diagnostics caused by inherited UV_FROZEN. It concerned missing-lockfile errors during lock/sync, not no-project warnings, and was fixed by astral-sh/uv#17318.

items.title: Use a dedicated error message when lockfile can't be found
items.reason: Merged January 2026; made missing-lockfile errors identify UV_FROZEN or UV_LOCKED as their source. The diff leaves the no-project warning unchanged, so this report is not a regression of that fix.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged PRs using the exact warning, --no-project with UV_FROZEN, UV_LOCKED, and UV_NO_SYNC separately, and broader terms including no-op, ignored settings, spurious warnings, environment variables, and area:error-messages. Removed version/platform constraints and searched historical fixes; inspected candidate comments, timelines, PR reviews, and diffs. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#10743 because its similar warning concerns dependency-group/project discovery, and astral-sh/uv#9772 because it requests warnings for resolution options ignored by frozen mode. No duplicate found.

type_reason: The 0.13.3 source confirms misleading diagnostics: inherited UV_FROZEN triggers a warning naming --frozen even though no such flag was supplied. FrozenSource retains the environment/CLI distinction, but this warning ignores it. UV_NO_SYNC has similar flag-only wording; UV_LOCKED already identifies its environment source but still warns. No existing item tracks this specific problem, and the historical missing-lockfile fix addressed a different diagnostic.
summary: No duplicate found. astral-sh/uv#5856 and astral-sh/uv#5977 explain the warning's origin; astral-sh/uv#17259 and astral-sh/uv#17318 provide related precedent for environment-aware diagnostics.
draft_response: The current `--no-project` warning checks whether frozen mode is enabled and always names `--frozen`, even when it came from `UV_FROZEN`. That explains the misleading output you're seeing. The source already records where frozen mode came from, so this warning can distinguish inherited settings from explicit flags. A targeted next step is to suppress the warning for environment-only settings and review `UV_NO_SYNC` and `UV_LOCKED` consistently. For now, `uv run --no-project --no-frozen test.py` overrides `UV_FROZEN` for that invocation.
